snippet.title: Your friend won't download anything? Nobody has to. #Shorts
snippet.description:
Free online party games in your browser. Create a room on GameBuddies.io, send the link to your group chat, and everyone joins from their phone, laptop or TV. No download, no sign-up.
In the trailer: Canvas Chaos, Bluffalo, Tier Battle, BlindSpot and Kaboom Buddies, five of 20+ free games, plus built-in video chat.
